fields.description: Issue includes a lengthy political exposé/attack on State's Attorney Vernon Hawthorne alleging protection of murder suspects, political manipulation, and grand jury abuses, with references to state politics and Miami Beach gambling interests. Also contains local election commentary and editorials, society/campus notes, sports coverage and horse-racing tip service advertisements, and extensive local business advertising oriented to Miami and Miami Beach entertainment and nightlife.
